import ctypes
import os

# Load the shared libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the types
class GSLBlock(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('size', ctypes.c_size_t),
                ('data', ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double))]

# Define the function prototypes
gsl.gsl_block_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(GSLBlock)
gsl.gsl_block_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t]

gsl.gsl_block_calloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(GSLBlock)
gsl.gsl_block_calloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t]

gsl.gsl_block_free.restype = None
gsl.gsl_block_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLBlock)]

def allocate_and_free_block(n):
    # Allocate the block
    block = gsl.gsl_block_calloc(n)
    if not block:
        return False
    
    # Check if the data is initialized to zero
    for i in range(n):
        if block.contents.data[i] != 0.0:
            return False
    
    # Free the block
    gsl.gsl_block_free(block)
    return True

# Test cases
def assert_test():
    assert allocate_and_free_block(10) == True, "Test case 1 failed"
    assert allocate_and_free_block(0) == True, "Test case 2 failed"
    assert allocate_and_free_block(100) == True, "Test case 3 failed"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
